items.text: Rams optimistic Puka Nacua (calf, Q) will play vs Raiders. Felt better Saturday; 'as long as no setbacks, feel good about available.' Confirmed confidence Sunday morning.
items.why: Calf improved Saturday; team sources positive pre-kickoff window
items.implication: Maintain elite WR1 usage if active; monitor warmups/inactives ~90min pre
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets if clears; Adams already IR elevates him further

items.text: Breece Hall (quad, Q after 3 misses) unlikely to play vs Dolphins. May workout but not full participant yet; bit early for return.
items.why: Limited practices only; sources say early for full return
items.implication: Continue sitting; Braelon Allen lead role in good matchup
items.opportunity: Allen workhorse snaps/carries/targets if Hall out

items.text: Ravens ruled Lamar Jackson OUT vs Bengals with high ankle sprain; third straight miss, Tyler Huntley starts again. Was close but not ready; expected next week.
items.why: High ankle sprain; limited practice but downgraded Saturday
items.implication: Huntley QB start; Ravens pass game less explosive, Flowers/Andrews/Likely volume stable but ceiling lower
items.opportunity: Huntley starts; potential slight uptick for Zay Flowers efficiency or Bengals D

items.text: Giants RB Cam Skattebo expected to resume lead back role vs Texans. JJ McCarthy long leash.
items.why: Sources confirm expected lead role Sunday
items.implication: Solid RB2/flex with volume; start with confidence

items.text: Packers activated RB Josh Jacobs from exempt; expected to play Sunday. Also Tank Dell, Christian Kirk, Jordan Mason, Jonah Coleman activated/expected.
items.why: Activated Saturday, listed expected to play
items.implication: Monitor snap share post-layoff; possible committee but startable
items.opportunity: Primary RB snaps/carries if clears full role

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both OUT for MNF vs Cowboys. Saquon Barkley Q but expected to play.
items.why: Ruled out Saturday; Saquon expected despite Q
items.implication: AJ Brown massive target upgrade; Goedert/others rise. Saquon start if active
items.opportunity: AJ Brown routes/targets/redzone spike; Saquon lead if clears

items.text: Jonah Coleman should be rostered in 100% of leagues; by EOY the Broncos RB you wish you had. Activated/expected.
items.why: Prior production (13 touches/TD) + Dobbins/Harvey inefficiency; IR return
items.opportunity: Committee or lead potential in DEN backfield

items.text: Lamar (ankle), Puka (calf), Breece (quad) statuses crucial for DFS main slate. Hoping early news. Sneaky scratches: Brian Robinson, Jahwar Jordan, Tyler Warren, Emeka Egbuka.
items.implication: Pivot plans ready; beneficiaries of scratches (e.g. Bijan, others)
items.opportunity: Role expansion for backups/handcuffs on OUT list

items.text: ETR Sunday injuries: Q Lamar/Puka/Breece/Baker/Dowdle/Mason/Kirk/Dell/Coleman etc. OUT Evans/Deebo/Adams/Rice/Love/Montgomery/Egbuka/Warren/Charbonnet/BRob. IN Jacobs/Judkins/Addison/Hockenson etc.
items.why: Full Sat night dump matching stars and depth
items.implication: Direct status + opps: Bijan full load (BRob out), Judkins/Jacobs/Addison upgrades, fade OUTs
items.opportunity: Bijan bellcow; Judkins lead; Addison volume; reverse if INs change

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT (hamstring); Bijan Robinson full bellcow expected. Confirmed across sources.
items.implication: Bijan massive upgrade to true workhorse

items.text: Saquon Barkley 'in line' to play MNF vs DAL (RB15); efficient when healthy, great matchup.
items.implication: Strong RB1/2 if clears; monitor MNF status

items.text: Rarely buy RB-as-WR hype but tempted by CMC lining up more in slot amid 49ers WR injuries (Evans/Deebo out) and Kaelon Black presence. CMC smiled at question.
items.why: Dire WR situation + CMC comment/smile; usually skeptic but this case different
items.implication: CMC ceiling boost via routes/targets in slot; strong start
items.opportunity: Increased slot snaps, routes, targets for CMC

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10): back in real role, Bears good for yardage. Also loved DeVonta pre-OUT.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; even better with DeVonta OUT

items.text: Loves Tucker Kraft @ DET (TE6): Lions TE buffet (9 TDs allowed, many 14+ pts).
items.why: Elite TE matchup vs Lions defense

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs NE (WR32): 90% outside targets likely shadowed by Gonzalez; low floor history.
items.why: Nasty matchup + outside role + inconsistent production

items.text: Hates Travis Kelce @ SEA (TE9): tough pass D matchup.
Hates Josh Jacobs @ DET (RB18): workload question after long layoff.
items.implication: Cautious start even if active; monitor

items.text: Loves Jaylen Warren @ NO (RB9), Chuba Hubbard vs TB (RB10), Bucky Irving @ CAR (RB12): big workloads in friendly matchups.
